name: Mat ong U Minh
summary: Mật ong U Minh is honey from the melaleuca flowers of U Minh Hạ, taken from gác kèo ong, the rafters keepers set up to draw the bees. Eat it by the spoon or carry a jar home.
origin: U Minh Hạ, which Cục Du lịch Quốc gia Việt Nam calls the largest melaleuca forest in the country. The provincial science office registered a shared brand, and Nhân Dân and VOV list mật ong U Minh Hạ as a collective trademark.
culture: Gác kèo ong was recognized with ba khía salting as national intangible heritage, as Người Lao Động reported in 2019. A Vietnam record for a bee colony was set at the 2022 Hương rừng U Minh festival.
howToEat: By the spoon, or carried home in a jar.
where: U Minh Hạ, and jars in the Cà Mau city market.
seoTitle: Mat ong U Minh — melaleuca honey
